title: Attunements
wikitext:
[[Attunements]] are a sub-set of [[Elementalist]] spells that provide standard [[energy management]] for the caster - being most efficient when specializing on one attribute.

Non-elite attunement spells are self-target [[enchantment]]s that cost 10 energy, last 60 seconds (at attribute level 15) and grant 30% energy cost refund (+1 absolute energy).

The [[Elemental Attunement|elite attunement]] stacks with the other ones and gives an additional 50% refund leading to almost no cost if combined with these.
